profile.name: Frédéric Crousaz
profile.headline: Event Officer / Coordinateur d'événements & opérations
profile.summary: Professionnel de la gestion opérationnelle d'événements avec cinq années d'expérience dans l'organisation de grandes conférences internationales, la mise en place des inscriptions et la conclusion de contrats fournisseurs jusqu'à la livraison sur site. jobs.title: Cultural Activities Officer at 70% - Schools and Seniors Coordinator
jobs.description: La Comédie de Genève is a creative theatre whose role is to showcase the scene of French-speaking Switzerland and present creations from major European stages. A true production tool with several workshops, dedicated to contemporary creation and serving artists, La Comédie de Genève offers a multidisciplinary programme highlighting creations from here and elsewhere. Within this framework, the Cultural Activities sector is looking, as part of a replacement following a departure, for a   Cultural Activities Officer at 70% Schools and Seniors Coordinator   Tasks and Responsibilities Take on the role of ambassador for the theatre with the main missions of providing access to art, giving access to its voice, and enabling community building by designing and implementing cultural action projects, mainly aimed at pupils, seniors, institutions and associations, but also people affected in their mental health. Promote the institution’s programme to institutional, associative and cultural partners by working with diverse audiences. Create and offer mediation around performances taking into account the specificities of the audiences welcomed. Participate in prospecting and developing new partnerships thanks to your network in the social, art and culture fields. Ensure the implementation and coordination of projects and be proactive regarding the programming of the Pont des Arts.   Profile and Required Skills You hold a Bachelor’s degree in the artistic field, educational sciences, social work or an equivalent qualification. You have training or experience in mediation in the cultural sector as well as in project management. You know the French-speaking Swiss landscape related to the school system and are familiar with institutions for senior audiences. You know how to communicate and interact with all audiences, without exception. You are organised and proactive, while having excellent interpersonal skills and ease working both autonomously and in a team. You are adaptable, solution-oriented and appreciate working in multidisciplinary teams while managing unforeseen events. The hours are regular, but you will be required to work hours related to theatre life, that is to say evenings, weekends and public holidays. While technical skills and experience are essential for this position, La Comédie de Genève places importance on human skills and respect for values of hospitality and open-mindedness.   Employment Conditions Offered by La Comédie Contract type: permanent contract Activity rate: 70% Start date: January 2027 (handover planned between November and December) Salary conditions: Current salary policy and many social benefits   La Comédie is an employer offering a work environment where everyone is treated with respect and dignity, inclusively: we welcome applications from people regardless of their gender, origin, age, disability or other.   Application File Please send your complete application file (cover letter, CV, copies of diplomas or any other supporting documents) only via Job’up:   Application deadline: 21 October 2026

jobs.title: Manager of the Geneva Houses 80–100% | Immediate start or to be agreed
jobs.description: For our two Ronald McDonald Family Rooms in Geneva, we are looking for a committed individual capable of combining operational management, family support, team leadership and local fundraising. Every day, children are born prematurely, suffer accidents or fall suddenly ill. To enable families to stay close to their child during these difficult times, the Ronald McDonald Children’s Foundation has been offering them a "temporary home" close to hospitals since 1994. With seven Family Rooms in Basel, Bern, Geneva, Lucerne, St. Gallen and Zurich, we create a reassuring environment when family proximity is most precious. In Geneva, our two houses accommodate up to nine families. Their operation is ensured by three staff members as well as volunteers.   Your area of responsibility Operational management of the two Family Rooms in Geneva Support for families from their arrival to their departure Leadership and development of the team and volunteers Guarantee and continuous development of quality standards Budget responsibility and management of operating accounts Active fundraising and development of sustainable partnerships Planning of communication, networking and fundraising activities   Your profile Several years of professional and leadership experience in a service-oriented environment Empathy, organisational skills and strong solution orientation Practical mindset and interest in a varied professional daily routine Availability for regular weekend shifts Excellent command of French, good knowledge of German, English is a plus Residence in the Geneva region   What we offer you Meaning and impact A meaningful activity with a direct social impact. Varied relationships Contacts with families, hospital partners, companies, foundations and other stakeholders. Room for manoeuvre Great autonomy, short decision-making processes and space for your ideas. Development The opportunity to sustainably develop the Geneva houses and strengthen their regional anchoring.   Your application Join our team and help shape the future of our Family Rooms in Geneva. We look forward to receiving your complete application dossier, accompanied by a cover letter.   Providing closeness. Supporting families. Acting together.   Ronald McDonald House Switzerland | Public utility foundation funded by donations

jobs.description: Joining Assura means evolving in a collaborative and dynamic environment where everyone plays an essential role and contributes to a meaningful mission. Every day, we put our energy and expertise at the service of our clients, supporting them in their health decisions. Want to join us? Then, nice to meet you! Solid experience in sales as well as proven experience in team management. A genuine interest in talent development and supporting colleagues towards collective success. A pragmatic approach to challenges, combined with positive energy and a strong solutions orientation.     Your benefits Attractive social benefits and significant reduction on health insurance Initial full-time 4-week training and ongoing training valued by a federal certification Flexibility and ease in your organisation Variable pay linked to performance   Start date? : to be agreed Activity rate ?: 100%

jobs.title: Senior Event Manager
jobs.description: People at 1800 metres above sea level shape luxury mountain travel. Our dynamic and international team offers our guests smart luxury for an unparalleled holiday experience. As a team member of the luxurious Kulm Group, you are part of the key to our success. Together we make every stay inspiring, unique and distinctive. And as such, we live our culture: discreet luxury, inspiration and life experience. Together we make this possible. This is your chance to become part of our defining culture: What you will achieve with us Elegant gala dinners, exclusive weddings, high-profile business events and bespoke celebrations – across two of Switzerland’s most renowned establishments. As a Senior Event Manager , you will oversee the entire planning process from enquiry to operational handover, ensuring that every event at both the Kulm Hotel St. Moritz and the Grand Hotel Kronenhof Pontresina is precisely planned, efficiently coordinated and flawlessly executed. Your responsibilities: Operational detailed planning & implementation: Seamless takeover of confirmed bookings from Sales; detailed coordination of all processes including room concepts, F&B procedures, technology and individual guest requests. Hub within the house: Accurate creation and timely distribution of Function Sheets (BEOs) as well as daily close coordination with Banqueting, Kitchen, Service, Technical Services and Front Office of both establishments. Presence & on-site support: Point of contact for organisers and clients during the event on site, conducting briefings on location and ensuring smooth operations. Interface: Preparation and leadership of internal event meetings to ensure all operational departments are perfectly briefed and prepared. Leadership & quality: Leadership and development of the Event Coordinator as well as co-creation of clear operational standards and templates. Follow-up: Recording all services provided in the PMS/CRM to prepare error-free final billing. Who you are Education & experience: Ideally a bachelor’s degree or training in hospitality, event management or business administration, with at least three years’ experience in hotel events or event planning, preferably focusing on meetings, incentives, weddings and private celebrations in the luxury segment. Organisational talent: Exceptional attention to detail, a confident sense of priorities and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously. Process & system knowledge: Proficient use of PMS, CRM and event management systems as well as excellent Microsoft Office 365 skills. Personality: Reliable, solution-oriented and resilient; you build sustainable relationships with discerning guests as well as all operational departments. Language skills: Fluent and polished German and English, both spoken and written; additional languages are an advantage. Start date: October or by arrangement. If you would like to help shape the future of the event sector within the Kulm Group, we look forward to receiving your complete application documents. Benefits At the Kulm Group, our employees are at the heart of our success. We offer attractive development opportunities, comfortable accommodation, affordable meals in the staff restaurant, and numerous discounts.

jobs.title: Event Manager (80–100 %)
jobs.description: The Goldau Nature and Animal Park delights around 450,000 visitors annually. On 42 hectares, around 100 European wild animal species live. Approximately 200 employees and numerous volunteers are committed to nature and species conservation, education, and research, and sustainably develop the scientifically managed animal park. Do you combine entrepreneurial thinking with a passion for events and hospitality? In this key position, you are responsible for the event business from the first customer enquiry to successful on-site execution. In doing so, you actively develop our event offerings and create special experiences in a unique natural setting. We are looking for a personality to join us immediately or by arrangement as Event Manager (80–100 %) Your tasks You are responsible for the acquisition, planning, organisation, and execution of events from A to Z You prepare and negotiate offers, contracts, and calculations and develop schedules You coordinate events with internal departments and lead or instruct the involved employees You maintain existing customer relationships, acquire new customers, and identify sales and additional sales potential You further develop the event offering and design new, attractive formats for day, event, and seminar guests You manage one employee and coordinate the staff deployed for events Your profile Education or further training in event management, hospitality, gastronomy, or tourism with relevant professional experience Several years of experience in independently planning and implementing demanding events Sound knowledge of gastronomy and a strong understanding of operational processes, quality, and service Strong organisational and coordination skills as well as a structured, reliable, and independent working style Entrepreneurial thinking, creativity, and a good sense for attractive offers and market potential Resilience and calmness, even with several simultaneous events Our offer Responsible role with scope for design and decision-making and the opportunity to actively further develop the event offering Meaningful work in a unique environment with nature and wildlife Diverse event portfolio with different customer groups Appreciative leadership culture and collaboration with committed employees Modern infrastructure and attractive employment conditions with various fringe benefits Application and contact We look forward to receiving your complete application documents, including your expected annual gross salary. For questions, Simon Widmer, Head of Hospitality, is happy to assist you at 041 859 06 31 .

jobs.description: "Swiss handball strengthens the cohesion of a modern, constantly changing society" To further develop our own events from international matches and cup finals to partner and community occasions, we are immediately or by arrangement seeking a creative, entrepreneurial and implementation-strong personality as: Head of Events & Experiences 80-100% Your area of responsibility Event development & fan experience: You consistently develop our event formats and the entire fan journey. With coherent dramaturgy, entertainment and surprising moments, you make international matches, cup finals and other SHV events special experiences before, during and after the event. Innovation & technology: You combine live experiences with digital possibilities, data and new technologies and transfer relevant impulses from other areas & industries. Event, hospitality and activation offerings: Together with marketing & sponsorship, you identify new commercial potentials and develop activatable event and hospitality offers with added value for fans, partners and the association. Planning & control: You are responsible for concepts, schedules, budgets, service providers and partners and ensure quality, cost-effectiveness and reliable implementation. Operational event implementation: You manage the preparation and on-site execution, keep an overview even in dynamic situations and pitch in where needed. Team leadership & collaboration: You lead a small event team as a player-coach and work closely with marketing & sponsorship, communication & marketing, sport and external partners. In this position, you not only shape individual events but also influence how people experience Swiss handball. You combine creative ideas with entrepreneurial thinking and operational excellence with the aim of creating enthusiasm and sustainable economic success equally. Your profile Several years of experience in the conception and implementation of complex events or live experiences – for example in sport, entertainment, festivals, brand experience or hospitality Strong sense for target groups, dramaturgy, entertainment and the details that make an event a genuine and successful experience Ability to think impact, quality and cost-effectiveness together as well as to recognise and consistently develop potentials Structured, independent and solution-oriented working style with high reliability, resilience and enjoyment of operational responsibility Openness to new technologies, data and impulses from other industries as well as courage to constructively question the status quo and try new things Inspiring, team-oriented personality who provides guidance, takes responsibility and effectively brings together different internal and external stakeholders You do not just want to manage existing processes but rethink events and implement them excellently at the same time. You do not only ask: "How have we done it so far?" but also: "How good could it become?" In doing so, you keep the needs of the fans as well as those of our teams, partners and other stakeholders in mind. Our offer We promote an open, team-oriented culture where innovation, ownership and flexibility are highly valued. You will have plenty of scope for design, short decision-making paths and the opportunity to visibly further develop the event world of Swiss handball. If you want to create live experiences that people will still talk about the next day, you will score a direct hit with us! From winter 2026, we will move: From Olten to Cham into new offices right next to the OYM College, see www.oym-college.ch . Further information about the Swiss Handball Association can be found at www.handball.ch .

jobs.title: Executive Sous Chef (m/f/d) 100% - Event Catering without Split Shifts
jobs.description: Fancy gastronomy with adrenaline? Forget dusty gastro standards: At Ullrich Hospitality AG based in Arlesheim BL, we create experiences that stay in the memory! As one of the leading event catering companies in Switzerland, we bring unique concepts to life - from stylish galas and exclusive corporate events to thundering large-scale events with up to 6,500 guests, as well as cool street food projects. Whether in our own event locations or on site with our clients. We combine the strength of a market leader with the freedom and dynamism of a modern lifestyle company. With us, you won’t find a rigid routine but a young, ambitious team with a genuine hands-on mentality: We support each other, think differently, and deliver top performance wherever celebrations take place. Are you looking for a place where you can fully invest your energy, actively shape things, and grow beyond yourself together with us? Welcome to the world of Ullrich! Ullrich Hospitality is part of Ullrich Enterprise AG . Under its umbrella, two other companies operate. Besides the event sector, we are also strong in back office: Ullrich Treuhand GmbH manages mandates from various industries and ensures order and clarity - from financial accounting to controlling and human resources. Ullrich Konzepte GmbH acts as a strategic driver, supports companies in business development, and develops innovative gastro concepts that go far beyond the ordinary. Do you want not only to stand at the stove but actively shape the culinary future of the Swiss event industry? In our kitchen, you won’t find dusty routine: We tinker with innovative food concepts, rock the biggest events in the country together, and create moments that remain memorable. You are a sous chef personality with pronounced leadership, organisational and executive experience, have deep gourmet understanding, and are looking for a genuine key role as the right hand of our chef de cuisine - and all that without tiresome split shifts? Then you are exactly right at Ullrich Hospitality! As Sous Chef (m/f/d) 100% , you form a strong leadership duo together with a second sous chef directly alongside our chef de cuisine. You take co-responsibility for the operational kitchen management, administrative planning, and leadership of our core team as well as the variable seasonal crew. Your tasks with us: Right hand of the Chef de Cuisine: You actively support our head chef in planning, organisation, and concept development. In his absence, you take over overall management as deputy of the head chef. Operational support & team guidance : You work closely with the head chef and the second sous chef. Together you lead our fixed core team of 6 employees (including 2 apprentices) in catering production and at event assignments. Flexible seasonal team : Depending on the season, event volume, and workload, you get more involved in operational business and ensure the training and guidance of our variable employees. Quality & gourmet feeling: You ensure that every dish - from exclusive business caterings to impressive large-scale events - meets the highest gourmet standards in taste and appearance. Planning & admin: You have administrative processes under control (duty planning, production planning, recipe standardisation, compliance with HACCP and hygiene regulations, etc.) and ensure structured workflows on site. Event & catering assignments: You actively assist at caterings and events throughout Switzerland - in our own locations and on site with our clients. Requirements Training & experience: Completed training as a cook EFZ as well as solid experience in gourmet/star gastronomy. Catering & event experience: Ideally, you already have experience in the event catering sector and keep a cool head even in high dynamics. Leadership & organisation: You bring extensive leadership experience, have already led larger teams, and independently managed administrative planning and organisation. You have experience in clearly guiding variable employees as reinforcement of the core team during seasonal peaks and ensuring uniform standards. Open personality: You are an inspiring, communicative, and winning personality - in short: a real doer who likes to be at the forefront, enthuses their team, and does not disappear into the background. Language skills: Very good German and good English skills for smooth communication in the multinational team. Benefits No split shifts: With us, you work in continuous shifts instead of fragmented workdays. No hours of waiting between shifts - so your free time really remains your time. Company holidays: Two weeks of company holidays in summer as well as two weeks over Christmas and New Year for your recovery are always guaranteed. Top location & infrastructure: Modern workplace on the dynamic site in Arlesheim directly by the Birs recreational area (perfect for breaks by the water). Plenty of parking spaces on site and excellent public transport connections. Strong team spirit: Dynamic environment with flat hierarchies, an open informal culture, and team events that bond.   Ready to help shape the top of our kitchen? Send us your complete application and bring your experience to Ullrich Hospitality!
